youtube.title: Ocarina of Time Sells 5.2 Million in Four Days on Switch 2
youtube.description: The Ocarina of Time remake moved 5.2 million copies in four days, a record for any Nintendo-published Switch 2 game, and the $520 Zelda edition console pushed Switch 2 to its best US sales week of 2026. Here's what the numbers look like for your wallet, and why the $60 game is the better buy than the box. Sources: Nintendo via Insider Gaming, Eurogamer and GameSpot, with Circana data from Mat Piscatella.
title_variants: Ocarina of Time Just Broke Nintendo's Switch 2 Sales Record
Zelda Sold 5.2 Million and Lifted Switch 2 to Its Best Week

claims.claim: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Switch 2 sold over 5.2 million units worldwide in its first four days after launching November 5, 2026.
This is the highest global sales for any Nintendo-published Switch 2 game in its first four days.
The remake has a 96 on Metacritic and a user score of 9.6.
Switch 2 had its highest dollar sales week of 2026 in the US, according to Circana analyst Mat Piscatella, driven by the Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition console.
The 40th Anniversary Edition console is priced at $520 and does not include a copy of the game.
The game is priced at $60 digitally and $70 on a physical cartridge.

issues.quote: I'd grab the cartridge and skip the box. sixty dollars digital

check.summary: All factual claims (5.2M units in four days, record for Nintendo-published Switch 2 titles, Metacritic 96 and user score 9.6, Circana/Piscatella best US dollar sales week of 2026, $520 console sold without the game, $60 digital / $70 cartridge) are supported by the sources. Buy/skip advice is clearly framed as the narrator's opinion. On-screen cards, title and description check out.
